jobs.title: Air Quality & Acoustics Business Line Leader - Environmental Services (Multiple Locations)
jobs.description:
Description

The Air Quality & Acoustics Business Line Lead (BLL) is responsible for the strategic growth, financial performance, market positioning, and long-term success of the Air Quality & Acoustics Business Line. The BLL partners with the Technical Service Leader (TSL) to align technical excellence with national market growth. Collaborating closely with Regional Office leadership and Global Practice leadership, the BLL drives business strategy, resource forecasting, digital transformation investments, and growth initiatives. The BLL serves as the primary point of contact between the business line and the National Sales Team.

Financial Performance & Accountability

Drive business performance through sales, revenue, gross margin, backlog, and utilization metrics. Develop annual business plans and growth strategies. Identify and implement profitability and scalability initiatives.

Market Strategy & Business Development

Formulate and execute national growth strategies. Lead major pursuits, capture planning, and executive-level client engagement. Champion commercialization of new service offerings and digital solutions.

Recruiting & Workforce Planning

Collaborate with TSLs and Regional Offices to forecast workforce demand and secure resources necessary to achieve business-line growth objectives. Identify future business capabilities required to support market growth and communicate those needs to TSLs and Regional Leadership. Support strategic workforce planning and succession planning.

Utilization & Resource Management

Monitor national utilization and capacity. Drive cross-regional collaboration to balance workloads. Establish utilization targets and business objectives that support efficient delivery.

National Business Line Leadership

Align regional teams around common strategic goals. Lead business-line vision, investment priorities, and national growth initiatives. Partner with TSLs to ensure business objectives are supported through consistent technical execution and delivery practices.

Client Relationships & Industry Presence

Build and sustain strategic client relationships. Strengthen Burns & McDonnell’s brand through industry engagement and thought leadership.

Leadership Development

Mentor future business leaders, seller-doers, and project managers. Support succession planning for key business-line leadership positions. Foster a culture of innovation by supporting investments in new service offerings, digital solutions, and market differentiation.

Qualifications

Bachelor Degree in engineering, construction management or related degree from accredited program and 17 years applicable experience required.
Prior experience on construction project sites or executing program management in the industries of aviation, commercial, energy, government, manufacturing, oil & gas, process, transmission & distribution, or water is preferred.
Demonstrated success in business development, client management, and team leadership preferred.
Experience supporting modern delivery methods and digital transformation initiatives preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, demanding work environment, ability to work overtime on short notice.
Excellent computer skills and proficiency using Microsoft Office.
Ability to work collaboratively with others (owners, contractors, engineers, designers) in a multi-disciplined project team environment to resolve design or drawing issues as appropriate and to accomplish objectives.
Strong experience with document control, scheduling, cost control and project management software.

Compensation

$180,000.00-330,000.00 Yearly

The expected compensation range for this position is displayed in compliance with all local/state regulations. The expected compensation range for this position is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to: individual education, qualifications, prior work experience and work location. The total annual compensation package will consist of a base salary and eligibility to participate in our discretionary year-end incentive bonus program.

Benefits

Our extensive benefits package takes care of you so that you can focus on doing great work. From insurance and disability to time off and wellness programs, we provide the tools to meet your needs. As part of being 100% employee-owned, eligible employees participate in our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) in addition to our 401(k) retirement program. For more information, please visit the Benefits & Wellness page.

This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist/Contaminated Land (FIFO) - Northern Territory
jobs.description:
Major Metals Refinery Closure
12-month full time, site-based project (extension possible)
FIFO (2:1) from any Australian location to Nhulunbuy, Northern Territory

About The Project

Tetra Tech Coffey is delivering environmental and contaminated land services to support a major metals refinery closure in Northern Territory, a major component of a broader decommissioning program.

Works involve remediation tracking, contaminated materials management, validation of remediation scopes, and compliance oversight in a complex remote industrial environment

The Role

We are seeking an experienced (2 to 5 years) Contaminated Land Consultant (field‑based) to provide on-site soil validation advice and support, sampling supervision, and contaminated materials support during remediation earthworks.

You will work daily alongside the client, providing practical, technically defensible environmental advice to support the remediation objectives and maintain compliance with the Remediation Action Plan.

Key Responsibilities

Field Delivery

Collect soil and surface water samples, to complete contaminated soil and surface water assessments, delineation, and validation sampling.
Manage and maintain health and safety on a large remediation project with significant heavy plant movements.
Provide field-based material advice to the remediation contractor.
Oversee material tracking and compliance with the remediation action plan and the remediation validation plan.
Manage unexpected finds and provide advice to the remediation contractor.
Maintain strong QA/QC and field records.
Undertake field pH testing
Work collaboratively with site teams, technical and project management teams based offsite.

Contractor Interface

Act as the primary site contact for client requests and advice and manage technical delivery of requests in collaboration with the subject matter expert.
Support daily pre‑starts and toolbox talks.
Attend regular client meetings.
Balance production needs with environmental compliance.

Reporting & Compliance

Prepare field summaries and contribute to validation reporting.
Prepare material classification and other technical memorandums, based on ongoing site requirements.
Maintain chain‑of‑custody and coordinate laboratories.
Support EMP, HSE, and regulatory compliance obligations.

About You

You'll have:

You'll be a qualified Environmental Scientist with 2-5 years experience in contaminated land consulting.
Demonstrated experience conducting soil and surface water samples, assessments, delineation, and validation sampling on brownfield/industrial sites.
Experience supporting civil earthworks.
Strong documentation and communication skills.
Current, unrestricted Australian Drivers License.
Ability to meet company & project medical requirements.
Confident working independently in remote FIFO settings.

Highly Regarded

NT regulatory knowledge.
Large‑scale remediation or decommissioning experience.
FIFO or remote project experience.

What We Offer

Highly competitive salary; provision of mobilisation costs including flights, camp accommodation and meals.
2:1 roster (or 2:2 / 3:1 depending on candidate).
Opportunity to contribute to one of the Southern Hemisphere’s most significant industrial closure and remediation projects.
Long-duration project exposure within a technically complex heavy industrial environment.
Support from an experienced, highly credentialled Environmental Scientists.

About Us

Tetra Tech Coffey provides high-end environmental, geotechnical, digital, and engineering design consulting services in Australia, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea. Every day, our people come together to solve complex challenges for our clients.

With over 30,000 Tetra Tech colleagues across 550 offices globally, we deliver projects that improve lives through science, technology, and innovation.

Our commitment to creating lasting, measurable value is reflected in our global 1 Billion People Challenge , which tracks how our 100,000+ annual projects benefit people and communities around the world.
